description: StudyAIO update policy [D30-04]. Runs as the `renovate` job in a nightly GitLab pipeline schedule; every MR still needs a green pipeline and a human merge.

packageRules.description: Python: one MR per week for non-major bumps; the generated lock is edited per package and CI's pip check proves it stays consistent.
torch/torchvision carry +cpu local versions that only exist on the PyTorch index; bump them with scripts/lock-requirements.sh by hand.
The Playwright image tag must equal @playwright/test (see .gitlab-ci.yml e2e-tests).
Container and CI image digests: one weekly MR.
Stay on Python 3.12 until a deliberate upgrade.

pgvector/pgvector bundles Postgres: a tag change (pg16 to pg17, or another tag form) is a data migration and never automatic. Every update type except digest and pinDigest is off, so only a new digest of the tag already in use is proposed (base-image rebuilds); those stay in the weekly "container images" group above. Do not use a bare enabled:false here: it disables the dependency before lookup and no later rule can re-enable it.
Redis stays on 7 until a deliberate decision (licence and protocol changes in 8).
nginx: even minor = stable branch only.
cosign 3 changes signing defaults and flags used in ci-publish-image.sh and deploy.sh; upgrade deliberately.

customManagers.description: Images run via `docker run` in CI scripts and deploy.sh, annotated with a renovate comment.
